about: We look after properties rather than doing one job and leaving. The same crew that cuts the grass in July clears the drive in January, which is why they know where the edge of it is.
Most clients are on a schedule through the season, but one-off work — a clearance, a bed rebuilt, a hedge brought back under control — is a normal thing to ring about.
